commit_message:
presigned_upload: warn (or refuse) when a budgeted form targets a versioned bucket

On a bucket with versioning enabled, each re-post of one form stores a new
full version, so one budget reservation could store several times max_bytes.
The docs now scope the guarantee to unversioned buckets, and when a budget is
given presigned_upload reads the bucket's versioning status: it warns
(VersionedBucketWarning) by default, refuses with on_versioned_bucket='raise',
or skips the call with 'ignore'.

Fixes #31
